## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Data, apps, and AI in one clear drag-and-drop interface for workflow automation.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: clean, high-contrast, enterprise
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Ubuntu,
  display=Oswald, mono=Ubuntu Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700,
  800, 900
- Color palette: primary, success, warning, danger | Tokens: primary=#072C2C,
  secondary=#FF5F03, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#EDEADE, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: comfortable density mode

- patterns
- images

## Copy tone

- Tone: confident, helpful, friendly, professional.

## Design intent

Clean, high-contrast enterprise design for data-driven workflows with clear
drag-and-drop patterns and structured layouts.
